source_title: Rural Emergency Hospital timely and effective care
unit_or_scope: REH national quality measures July 2024 to June 2025
direct_observation: CMS publishes national process measures including median emergency-department time and time before transfer
missing_stage: local causal intervention continuity after transfer patient outcome and equity
evidence_status: official CMS open data; intermediate process measure
next_test: link facility-level REH measures to transfer completion follow-up and local access

unit_or_scope: US health-center and rural-health program visits 2025
direct_observation: HRSA reports 17.6 million virtual visits equal to 13 percent of all patient visits and 37 percent of mental-health visits and more than 522750 people served through rural-health programs
missing_stage: equitable completion quality clinical outcome durable workforce and local continuity
evidence_status: official HRSA year-in-review; aggregate reach not patient outcome
next_test: disaggregate by rural place population language disability service and completed-care result

source_title: Rural Community Hospital Demonstration financial platform
unit_or_scope: small rural hospitals fewer than 51 beds Medicare inpatient services and 24-hour emergency care
direct_observation: CMS reports improved Medicare inpatient margins and hospital leaders describing participation as crucial to financial viability
missing_stage: service-line availability travel appointment completion patient outcomes and causal access effect
evidence_status: official CMS model/evaluation; financial viability not universal access
next_test: compare hospital margins staffing open service lines transfers and patient continuity over time

source_title: CMS Rural Health Transformation award announcement
direct_observation: CMS announced 50 state awards under a 50 billion dollar five-year program; 10 billion dollars available each year from 2026 through 2030; first-year awards average 200 million dollars and range from 147 million to 281 million
missing_stage: local intervention spending staffing appointment access continuity and outcome
next_test: select a named state and trace award to county service line

source_title: GAO Rural Health Transformation implementation and monitoring report
direct_observation: GAO reports 10 billion dollars awarded to 50 states in year one; CMS plans progress discussions information review audits and site visits; up to 40 billion dollars remains conditional on satisfactory progress
missing_stage: actual implementation spending delivery workforce and patient results
evidence_status: official GAO report; implementation plan not outcome
next_test: match one state milestone to public spend staffing and service data

source_title: HRSA State of the U.S. Health Care Workforce 2025
unit_or_scope: US population and health professional shortage areas
direct_observation: As of December 2 2025 about 92 million people lived in a primary care HPSA 64 million in a dental HPSA and 137 million in a mental health HPSA; rural maldistribution is severe
missing_stage: program-attributable change named rural service and patient outcome
next_test: compare later HPSA and local workforce data with named program activity

unit_or_scope: metro and nonmetro workforce projections through 2038
direct_observation: HRSA 2023 to 2038 projections report a possible 58 percent physician shortage in nonmetro areas versus 5 percent in metro areas in 2038
missing_stage: actual recruitment retention local appointments and continuity
evidence_status: official HRSA projection; model not realized outcome
next_test: track named rural specialty and retention over time

source_title: HRSA Rural Access to Health Care Services RFI
unit_or_scope: HPSA MUA MUP and ZIP unmet-need methods
direct_observation: HRSA identifies geographic population and facility shortages and notes economic cultural and linguistic barriers; ZIP unmet-need methods combine health and socioeconomic measures
missing_stage: appointment completion travel language access trust and continuity
next_test: build county or ZIP service route with wait travel and completion measures

unit_or_scope: over 40000 square mile Montana-Wyoming service area and nine clinic locations
direct_observation: About 300 staff support school-based care and clinic-to-clinic telehealth; a hypertension-monitoring pilot enrolled 11 patients and telehealth represented almost 10 percent of visits
missing_stage: appointment completion clinical control workforce retention broadband and affordability
evidence_status: official HRSA named health-center case; reported service activity not causal outcome
next_test: trace patients from referral through visit monitoring result and follow-up continuity

source_title: Lānaʻi Community Health Center telehealth and travel
unit_or_scope: approximately 3300 island residents and specialist routes to Maui and Oʻahu
direct_observation: Patients often use the centre as a telehealth hub because home internet is unstable; staff coordinate specialist visits travel and follow-up while flights average about 320 dollars round trip and cancellations disrupt plans
missing_stage: travel cost appointment completion specialist continuity pregnancy outcomes and equitable insurance coverage
evidence_status: official HRSA named island case and access counterexample
next_test: follow one patient from local appointment through specialist travel authorization and return care

source_title: Yakima Neighborhood Health Services digital-literacy and telehealth navigation
unit_or_scope: homebound rural homeless and migrant patients in Central Washington
direct_observation: Community health workers help patients set up smartphones remote monitoring and appointments; a digital-literacy scale is recorded in health records and Medicaid payment changes supported additional hiring
missing_stage: completed appointment clinical outcome worker caseload privacy and sustained funding
next_test: match literacy score support contact appointment completion clinical result and CHW workload

source_title: Pennsylvania Rural Health Model global-budget hospitals
unit_or_scope: 18 participating rural hospitals and five payers through performance year 5 2023
direct_observation: CMS reports all 18 participating hospitals remained open and retained participation while staff capacity workforce shortages and reconciliation unpredictability remained constraints
closed_stage: financial platform and local access continuity
missing_stage: hospital service-line availability appointment completion patient outcomes affordability and causal comparison
evidence_status: official CMS evaluation; access preservation not universal outcome
next_test: compare participating service lines with nonparticipating rural hospitals on staffing wait and continuity"
